simulation.capabilities.summary: Read-only module/class metadata discovery. Reports module availability, preview evidence, stable FEAsolve unavailable in the supported profile, and entitlement notChecked.
limitations: Imports adsk.sim but never instantiates or invokes Simulation/Study objects. Runtime class docs supplement the known September 2026 SDK preview specification; missing docs never imply stability.
No Simulations.get: it can create a product. No study writes, mesh, solve, results, workspace activation or licensing checks.
Simulation/Study preview APIs are documented as unsuitable for distributed programs. Module presence is not solver support. Native command examples are returned, not executed.
